title: Holiday Lights Burnout Detection
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=festive:lights
| stats latest(current_watts) as current_watts, latest(expected_watts) as expected_watts by circuit
| eval drop_pct=round(100*(expected_watts-current_watts)/expected_watts,1)
| where drop_pct>20
| sort - drop_pct
description: Flags lighting circuits whose power draw has dropped enough to suggest failed bulbs or sections.
value: Power draw is a quick proxy for burnout when you do not want to inspect every strand manually.
implementation: Ingest festive-light readings with expected and current wattage; alert when the measured draw falls too far below plan.
visualization: Table of festive circuits with expected watts, current watts, and drop percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which light strands probably have burnt-out sections because the power draw has dropped more than expected.
